title: To repeat. 100% recommended
text:
We had a great time. All perfect... and although it's for children... you have to think... 
Very good deal. Recommended 100% we will repeat!
author: Cristinafn

title: Magical Magic Portal
text: We (a family of 4) thoroughly enjoyed the Magic Portal experience in Seville. It is a fun and engaging way to travel around parts of the city with your kids, take in some of the sites, all the while trying to save the world!! Antonio, who met us at the beginning and end point of our journey was a lovely guy, explained everything to us in detail and sent us on our merry way! I definitely recommend this experience if you are visiting Seville with a young family. The Callaghans from Ireland.
author: thev386

title: Fun and mysterious
